review_fix.cause: Prism heredoc descendants can lie outside their DefNode source span; source-offset filtering hid those nodes from the compact index.
review_fix.change: Compute exclusive subtree ends structurally from serialized node child fields in reverse preorder; index complete definition subtrees, including out-of-span heredoc bodies.
review_fix.coverage: Corpus 1004: eval-defined endless and regular heredoc methods, neighboring definitions, file-backed and synthetic filenames; evaluator/VM, hash indexes ON/OFF, normal/tight GC32. Corpus 1022 ordinary file heredoc preserved on evaluator/VM, hash ON/OFF.
